title: Finding
description: Normalized security vulnerability or quality finding produced by AuditAgent analysis pipeline.

id.description: Unique deterministic finding ID (e.g., SWC-107-001 or VULN-REENTRANCY-1)

confidence.description: Tool / LLM confidence that this finding is a true positive. High/Critical unverified findings are demoted to Low.

file.description: Relative path to target source file

evidence.description: Raw code snippet, trace, or AST extract proving the issue

explanation.description: Detailed explanation of vulnerability mechanics and exploit scenario

tool_source.description: Origin analyzer that detected the issue

verified.description: True if finding has been independently verified by a synthesized, successfully executed Foundry PoC exploit test

poc_path.description: Filepath to the synthesized Foundry test that executed and proved this vulnerability
